name: Anupam Finserv Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Anupam Finserv Ltd is in the business of financing and leasing[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is registered as a Non Deposit taking Non Systematically Important Non Banking Finance Company. It provides all kinds of Loans and Finance, viz. Personal, Business or Home loans. Apart from NBFC business, company also ventured into operating lease of vehicles

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.0% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.38% over last 3 years.
